design_ancestry_signals.summary: A person enters a persistent merged state with a living/organic ship while retaining distinguishable identity and relationship roles.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Model deep tool/system integration as linked state with preserved identity boundaries rather than replacement or possession.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Pilot, ship, and wingmate form an operational unit with distinct roles and ongoing coordination.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Represent collaborative agents/tools as a braid of participants with shared task state and separate provenance/authority lanes.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: Training explicitly develops the ability to handle several streams of information at once.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Universal Codex may show simultaneous task streams as spatially separate but coordinated lanes rather than flattening them into one activity feed.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: High-volume incoming telepathic signal requires filtering and assistance to keep ambient noise tolerable.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Use gain, attenuation, focus, and companion filtering as visible controls over signal density while preserving underlying source availability.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: One participant can amplify or extend another participant's signal without becoming its author.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Treat relays/boosts as transport metadata: source remains source, relay remains relay, and reach/intensity remain separate from authorship.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: A major transition changes available capabilities and perception while lineage to the prior state remains explicit.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Transformation animations should expose what changed, what persisted, and which capabilities became newly available.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: High-energy actions have explicit resource cost even when technically possible.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Separate possible, permitted, powered, affordable, and completed states in tool projections and receipts.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: A non-conscious pattern-sense influences action selection but is not perfectly controllable or infallible.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Prediction or recommendation surfaces should display confidence and uncertainty rather than visually presenting instinctive guidance as certainty.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: A participant quickly builds a usable model of unfamiliar languages through exposure.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Runa/Kelyran teaching can expose progressive recognition, approximation, confidence, and correction rather than a binary understood/not-understood state.

design_ancestry_signals.summary: The character is drawn to mechanics, programming, alien devices, and organic ships as systems to understand and manipulate.
design_ancestry_signals.codex_use: Projected tools may present inspectable living-system structure and invite puzzle-like exploration without hiding machine state.

candidate_ui.merge_machine: pre-link identity -> pairing -> merge/transition -> capability discovery -> multi-stream calibration -> active braid -> cost/receipt -> continued adaptation
visuals: three-strand braid for person/ship/wingmate with independently addressable strands
parallel thought-stream ribbons with local gain controls
relay halo that visibly shows source, relay, and recipients
transition ring that preserves a lineage filament to pre-merge state
capability glyphs appearing only after the state transition that grants them
resource-cost flare or depletion trace for high-energy actions

laws: Deep integration does not require identity collapse.
Transition can add capability without rewriting prior lineage.
Possible is not the same as costless.
